usedFor: Kitchen.co holds your clients, and ClickUp receives follow-up work when “New Client” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Kitchen.co, then “Create Task” in ClickUp
bestTemplate.why: A new client starts a task in the ClickUp list you pick, with title, assignee and description.

watchOut: “Create Task” adds a task per run, so “Folder Updated” in Kitchen.co would pile up tasks for one folder.
